title: Signature Vault Notes — What it is
description: Signature Vault Notes is Manon's original design: a local-first knowledge vault where every note is a plain file on the user's own disk and every block is a Signature-typed object that can be queried, scripted and chained into automations. It combines the cloud-workspace ergonomics of a block editor with the offline vault philosophy: no account required to read your own notes, deterministic export, and a built-in assistant that answers from the vault. It is made by Signature Systems (Justin Addam Higgins) and runs on Windows, macOS, Linux.
